title: HiveLearn
description: Read and author HiveLearn courses, events, quizzes, certificates, resources, leaderboards, tracks.
summary: Read and author HiveLearn courses, events, quizzes, certificates, resources, leaderboards, tracks.
offersHint: Read and author HiveLearn courses, events, quizzes, certificates, resources, leaderboards, tracks. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.hivelearn.app · Packages: npm:hivelearn-mcp · Requires headers: X-Hivelearn-Api-Key · Env vars: HIVELEARN_API_KEY

headers.name: X-Hivelearn-Api-Key

headerDocs.description: Your HiveLearn API key. Create one at Admin → API Keys in your HiveLearn community.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_community_me
toolsPreview.description: Returns the community the current API key is scoped to. Use this first whenever you need the community_id, owner, slug, or tier — the API key determines tenancy, you cannot switch community.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_members
toolsPreview.description: List members of the authenticated community. Returns id (profile uuid), role, email, display_name, avatar_url, and joined_at. Filter by role to find admins/owners.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_member
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single member by profile uuid. Returns the same fields as list_members for one row.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_member
toolsPreview.description: Change a member's role or ban status. role accepts member/moderator/admin (owner cannot be assigned via the API). Set is_banned=true to ban, false to lift. At least one field required.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_posts
toolsPreview.description: List community feed posts, newest first. Use category to filter (e.g. "announcements"). Returns id, title, content, category, author, reply counts, timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_post
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one post with full content. Reply thread is NOT included — this is the post itself only.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_post
toolsPreview.description: Publish a new post to the community feed. Either content (markdown) or content_json (tiptap) is required. content_format must match which field you sent. category is optional — omit for default "general".

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_post
toolsPreview.description: Edit an existing post. Only include fields you want to change. Use is_pinned to pin/unpin a post from the top of the feed.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_events
toolsPreview.description: List community events. Use upcoming=true for future events only (recommended for calendar UI). Returns id, title, start/end dates, event_type, location/meeting_url, attendee counts.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_event
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one event by id with full description and RSVP metadata.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_event
toolsPreview.description: Create a calendar event. Dates are ISO 8601 strings in UTC. For virtual events set meeting_url; for in-person set location. event_type controls which field the UI shows.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_event
toolsPreview.description: Edit an event. Set is_cancelled=true to cancel (preserves history). Set max_attendees=null to lift the cap.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_courses
toolsPreview.description: List courses in the authenticated community. status=published returns only courses visible to learners. Returns id, title, visibility, is_published, thumbnail_url, timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_course
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one course with full metadata (description, instructor, tags, flags). For the lesson tree use hivelearn_get_course_structure instead.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_course
toolsPreview.description: Create an empty course (no modules/lessons). Prefer hivelearn_create_course_outline when you already know the structure — it scaffolds course + modules + lesson placeholders in one call.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_course
toolsPreview.description: Edit course metadata. Use hivelearn_publish_course instead of setting is_published=true directly — publish runs validation.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_course_modules
toolsPreview.description: List modules (sections) of a course, ordered by sort_order. Modules group lessons; a course has 1..N modules.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_module
toolsPreview.description: Add a module to a course. sort_order is optional — server auto-appends if omitted.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_module
toolsPreview.description: Rename or reorder a module. To reorder lessons within a module use hivelearn_reorder_module_lessons.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_course_lessons
toolsPreview.description: List lessons of a course, optionally filtered to one module. Use hivelearn_get_course_structure for a nested tree.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_lesson
toolsPreview.description: Add a lesson to a course. content_type must match content_url (e.g. youtube URL → content_type:youtube). Set module_id=null to leave the lesson unassigned; otherwise pass a module uuid from list_course_modules.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_lesson
toolsPreview.description: Edit lesson metadata or move it between modules. To edit ONLY the content body use hivelearn_update_lesson_content (narrower scope, safer).

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_course_outline
toolsPreview.description: Scaffold an entire course in one call: course + modules + lesson placeholders (title/description only, no content yet). After this, loop over the returned lesson ids with hivelearn_update_lesson_content to fill in video/document URLs. This is the preferred first step when authoring a new course from a plan.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_lesson_content
toolsPreview.description: Replace just the content of a lesson — URL, content_type, and optional description/duration/thumbnail. Narrower than update_lesson; safe for bulk agent writes. Does NOT change title, sort_order, or module assignment.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_reorder_module_lessons
toolsPreview.description: Set the full lesson order within a module in one atomic call. Pass the desired final order as lesson_ids — every lesson currently in the module must appear exactly once.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_publish_course
toolsPreview.description: Publish a course: sets is_published=true after validating that every lesson has content_url. Returns error if any lesson is still empty — run hivelearn_get_course_structure to diagnose.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_course_structure
toolsPreview.description: Return a compact titles-only tree of the course: course → modules → lessons. Ideal for agents to plan reorders, spot empty lessons, or summarize a course. Does NOT include lesson body content.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_quizzes
toolsPreview.description: List quizzes, optionally scoped to a course or a specific lesson. Each quiz belongs to one lesson.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_quiz
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one quiz with metadata (passing_score, time_limit, max_attempts). Questions are NOT included — use hivelearn_list_quiz_questions.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_quiz
toolsPreview.description: Create a quiz attached to a lesson. passing_score is 0-100 (percent). Omit time_limit_seconds or max_attempts for unlimited.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_quiz
toolsPreview.description: Edit quiz settings. Cannot move a quiz to a different lesson — create a new one instead.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_quiz_questions
toolsPreview.description: List all questions for a quiz, ordered by sort_order. Each question carries its options and correct answer.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_quiz_question
toolsPreview.description: Add a question to a quiz. For multiple_choice: pass options as an array of { text, is_correct } objects — at least one must be is_correct:true. For true_false: omit options and set correct_answer (boolean).

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_quiz_question
toolsPreview.description: Edit a question. Changing question_type will require resupplying options or correct_answer to match the new type.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_enrollments
toolsPreview.description: List course enrollments, optionally scoped to one course or one user. Returns enrollment_id, user_id, course_id, status, progress %, enrolled_at, completed_at.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_enrollment
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one enrollment with status and progress.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_enrollment
toolsPreview.description: Enroll a user in a course. Both user_id and course_id must belong to the authenticated community. Duplicate enrollments are rejected.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_course_progress
toolsPreview.description: Aggregate lesson-completion progress for a course across enrolled users. Returns per-user percent_complete, last_accessed_at, completed_lesson_count.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_course_gradebook
toolsPreview.description: Quiz-score gradebook for a course: per-user quiz attempts, scores, pass/fail. Use for analytics or grading dashboards.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_certificates
toolsPreview.description: List issued certificates, optionally scoped to one user or one course. Returns id, user, course, verification_code, status, issued_at.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_certificate
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one certificate by id. Includes verification_code and download URL.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_certificate
toolsPreview.description: Issue a certificate of completion to a user for a course. Normally the platform auto-issues on course completion — use this tool for bulk backfill or manual awards.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_certificate
toolsPreview.description: Change a certificate status. Use "revoked" to invalidate (verify endpoint will reject).

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_verify_certificate
toolsPreview.description: Public verification lookup by verification_code. Returns { valid, certificate } if found and active. Use this when a third party presents a certificate code.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_resources
toolsPreview.description: List published resources in the authenticated community, newest first. Filter by folder_id, resource_type, or access_level. Returns id, title, resource_type, resource_url/file_url, access_level, counts (downloads, views, favorites), author. The internal storage key is never exposed.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_resource
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one published resource by id, with joined author. 404 if unpublished or in another community.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_resource
toolsPreview.description: Add a resource to the community library. Supply either resource_url (external link) or file_url (already-uploaded file) — at least one is required. price must be > 0 if set (omit for free). access_level defaults to public.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_resource
toolsPreview.description: Edit a resource. Only include fields you want to change. Set is_featured to surface it; set is_published=false to unlist.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_leaderboard
toolsPreview.description: Ranked member leaderboard for the community. period chooses the window: all_time (default), 30_day, or 7_day. Each entry carries rank and the points for the selected period, plus level info.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_member_points
toolsPreview.description: Full points breakdown for one member (by auth user id) in the community: total, per-category (posts/comments/events/courses/engagement), period totals, level. 404 if the member has no points record here.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_tracks
toolsPreview.description: List published learning tracks (curated course sequences) in the community, newest first. Returns id, title, description, difficulty_level, estimated_hours, flags.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_track
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one learning track by id with full metadata. For its ordered curriculum use hivelearn_list_track_courses.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_list_track_courses
toolsPreview.description: Return the ordered curriculum of a track: its courses with sort_order, is_required, and unlock_after_course_id (prerequisite gating).

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_get_track_progress
toolsPreview.description: Per-member progress through a learning track: enrolled_at, started_at, completed_at, total_courses, completed counts. Use for cohort/track analytics.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_create_track
toolsPreview.description: Create a learning track (curated course sequence). After this, add courses in order with hivelearn_add_track_course. is_published defaults to false — publish once the curriculum is set.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_update_track
toolsPreview.description: Edit a learning track. Only include fields you want to change. Set is_published=true to make it live.

toolsPreview.name: hivelearn_add_track_course
toolsPreview.description: Add a course to a track at a given position. sort_order sets the order within the track. Set unlock_after_course_id to a prerequisite course that must be completed first (omit/null for no gate). is_required defaults to true.
